column1: # Rung 1 (relational equivalence) arm set: Ch 3 §1, §4, §5. DRAFT (2026-10-20):
# do not submit until the pre-registration (docs/, daily note) fixes each G1-G4
# statistic, its sign and the arm contrast that tests it.
# Crossed design on the reference-r3 grid (45 cells; r 0.15/0.30/0.40, sigma 2,
# k 6, p 0.05, q 0, warm-up alpha 0.1, mu x 3 lambda pairs):
#   private  none | shock (noise s = 5 agents)
#   public   nbr   = neighbours only (production)
#            stale = announcement frozen at its tick-1 level, never refreshed,
#                    half the social signal (alpha 0.5): optimistic as the run grows.
#                    Since 2026-10-21 stale mode freezes the agent's view of the bank
#                    too: decisions simulate from the post-shock state plus the
#                    agent's own withdrawn neighbours.
#            fresh = the same announcement refreshed every tick (tracks the truth);
#                    the view is refreshed with it, so agents miss only non-neighbour
#                    withdrawals made within the current tick
#   Design note for the pre-registration: the nbr arms keep the fresh clone (agents
#   simulate from the true current state), so stale vs fresh isolates staleness,
#   while nbr vs stale also changes what the agent knows about the bank's books.
# = 12 arms x 45 cells x 250 runs. Production defaults in every row: fresh clone,
# double-count fix (default), legacy tie-break, geometric belief, summary logs.
